rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for introducing people and for presenting or recommending a person, idea, or proposal.

example.english: Let me introduce my new colleague to you.
example.traditional: 我介紹我個新同事畀你識。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaai3 siu6 ngo5 go3 san1 tung4 si6 bei2 nei5 sik1

rows.meaning: add or put into a system
rows.note: Use this when adding something into an existing system, mixture, or container.

example.english: You can introduce the new data into the system later.
example.traditional: 你遲啲可以將啲新資料加入個系統。
example.jyutping: nei5 ci4 di1 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 di1 san1 zi1 liu6 gaa1 jap6 go3 hai6 tung2

rows.note: Use this when bringing a new practice, technology, or system into use.

example.english: The company plans to introduce artificial intelligence to handle customer service.
example.traditional: 公司打算引入人工智能嚟處理客服。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 jan5 jap6 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 lai4 cyu2 lei5 haak3 fuk6

rows.note: Use this for a formal face-to-face introduction, especially when presenting one person to another.

example.english: Today I formally introduce two experts to the principal.
example.traditional: 我今日引見兩位專家畀校長認識。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jan5 gin3 loeng5 wai2 zyun1 gaa1 bei2 haau6 zoeng2 jing6 sik1
